query:
SELECT 'Senate' as type, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'General' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as general_ready, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Called' OR status = 'Certified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as called FROM senate_races
UNION ALL
SELECT 'House', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'General' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Called' OR status = 'Certified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM house_races
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Governor', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'General' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Called' OR status = 'Certified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM governor_races;
